stance_rationale: Forge preserves the 3-package hashes and produces visible OOS charts, but the admission evidence is not decision-grade: the mandated mailbox weights.csv and monthly_returns.parquet are absent, run_all.R reconstructs a static sleeve vector over 255 months instead of consuming the weights schedule, and the OOS NEW sleeve is set to zero rather than frozen. The package also lacks consistent DSR penalty handling and admits a failed Backtest Contract v1.0 build, so AX-002 and RF-F2/RF-F5 remain unresolved.

critical_concerns.description: The required mailbox weights.csv path is missing, while the stage fallback has only 155 monthly sleeve rows ending 2023-11; run_all.R does not consume this file and instead repeats optimizer high_20pct static sleeve weights across 255 months. This is the Iter-4-style single-snapshot risk under a denser wrapper.

monthly_returns.parquet is absent; the available portfolio_returns_monthly.csv covers 2005-02 to 2026-04, but it is generated by reconstructing static sleeve returns, not by a costed ticker-level walk-forward schedule with per-date universe and weights.

Lockbox OOS is not a frozen NEW sleeve buy-and-hold extension. Forge sets NEW return to zero after 2023-11, making hi20 effectively an 80% scaled S4 baseline; the OOS DM test then significantly favors baseline (t_NW=-5.1151). This does not validate the new sleeve out of sample.

The primary strict variant fails CAGR versus S4 and has significantly negative mean monthly return difference over the full 255 months (DM t_NW=-2.8959). The only 4-axis pass relies on the redistribute variant, which assumes lossless absorption of the NEW sleeve allocation by the legacy 4 sleeves.

DSR penalty is not applied consistently in Forge: alpha and optimizer candidate counts imply a larger combined trials penalty, while the risk package reports a global Bailey-LdP M=5 DSR and the baseline has no same-penalty evidence.
Backtest Contract v1.0 failed with date type mismatch and the package proceeds with fallback raw metrics only. That may be useful diagnostic output, but it is not a contract-compliant forge result.

Hard constraints are asserted through sleeve-level inheritance, not audited from ticker-level holdings. AX-007 multi-sleeve can justify more aggregate names, but it does not remove the need to verify per-date ticker weights, liquidity, cost, and turnover from actual holdings.

supporting_arguments: Actual md5s match the package audit: alpha 5285d10f5968f1233b886c86dd024d14, risk 25a440e08232fcfb953ca912bffaa13a, optimization 4f21fbc1b075a5b790da90acad4a68af.
alpha_scores.parquet is a real time-series artifact with 52,800 rows, 155 sig_dates from 2011-01-01 to 2023-11-01, and 695 unique tickers.
covariance.parquet in stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001 is PSD with min eigenvalue 0.01217 and condition number about 8.81.
equity_curve.png and oos_zoom_chart.png exist, and the strategy line is visible after the 2023-12-22 lockbox marker.
unresolved_disputes: Whether a static sleeve-level allocation can satisfy the Forge walk-forward evidence requirement for a KR QEPM admission decision.
Whether the redistribute variant is admissible evidence when the strict OOS implementation sets NEW to zero and baseline dominates.
Whether DSR should be recomputed with alpha plus optimizer candidate counts and applied equally to baseline and candidate.
Whether the Backtest Contract failure can be accepted as a partial pass or must block Judge S6 input.
Whether alpha PIT-C13/C14 accepted-timeline issues can remain inherited in downstream Forge evidence.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that the redistribute variant is a fair admit basis: it assumes the legacy 4-sleeve book can absorb the 20% NEW allocation without correlation, turnover, or OOS degradation, even though the strict lockbox path validates only an 80% scaled baseline and is dominated by S4.
rebuttal_required: Publish the mandated mailbox weights.csv or explicitly amend the artifact contract, then make run_all.R consume that schedule rather than reconstructing static weights from optimization_package.json.
Produce monthly_returns.parquet and ticker-level holdings/weights proving per-date long-only, sum_w=1, per-name cap, liquidity, cost, and turnover compliance.
Run the lockbox extension with frozen 2023-11 NEW holdings or document why OOS NEW=0 is the only permissible lockbox policy and remove any OOS NEW validation claim.
Recompute DSR with combined alpha plus optimizer candidates and apply the same penalty to candidate and baseline.
Fix the Backtest Contract v1.0 date issue and save a valid bt_result before Judge handoff.
rationalization_red_flags: TC drag ... negligible vs delta SR
CVaR cap infeasible / structural to KR equity baseline
Redistribute variant assumes baseline 4-sleeve absorbs NEW capacity without correlation degradation

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge provides useful diagnostics but does not supply a second clean PASS source under AX-008 because the decisive evidence depends on static sleeve reconstruction, OOS dead-weight handling, and incomplete DSR/contract compliance.

walk-forward 시계열 충분 (≥60 sig_dates)이고 single-snapshot 위험 없는가? 155 sig_dates exist, but run_all applies a static sleeve vector; single-snapshot risk is HIGH.
Lockbox period strategy NAV가 equity_curve에 visible한가? Yes, visible after 2023-12-22.
baseline 비교가 same-period · same-cost · same-DSR-penalty인가? Same-period baseline exists, but same DSR penalty evidence is absent.
